title.value: Special Issue on Novel Informatics Approaches to COVID-19 Research
title.justification: The title is clearly mentioned in the beginning of the document, indicating the thematic focus of this collection of papers.
title.quote: Special Issue on Novel Informatics Approaches to COVID-19 Research

analysis.description: This special issue of the Journal of Biomedical Informatics focuses on novel informatics approaches to COVID-19 research. It welcomes submissions of innovative methodologies in data processing, integration, visualization, and predictive modeling related to COVID-19, with an emphasis on informatics strategies that can aid in understanding and combating the pandemic.

type.justification: The paper calls for submissions that describe "novel methodological results," which suggests an empirical focus on applied methods.
type.quote: Investigators are encouraged to submit clear and detailed descriptions of their novel methodological results.

name.justification: The focus is specifically on COVID-19 and the informatics approaches to research related to it, as detailed in the description and topics of interest.
name.quote: This Special Issue aims to highlight the development of novel informatics approaches to collect, integrate, harmonize, and analyze all types of data relevant to COVID-19 in order to accelerate knowledge acquisition and scientific discoveries in COVID-19 research.

name.justification: Included under epidemic monitoring and prediction topics related to COVID-19 transmission among multiple sources of data.
name.quote: Epidemic monitoring and prediction of transmission by linking multiple sources of data and application of statistical and machine learning methods

name.justification: Clinical informatics is mentioned as a field of interest especially in the context of clinical data and electronic health records related to COVID-19.
name.quote: Clinical informatics for observational studies using electronic health records, e.g., to support treatment and outcome studies

name.justification: Imaging informatics approaches are identified as relevant, especially diagnostic scans such as chest X-rays and CTs for COVID-19.
name.quote: Imaging informatics approaches (e.g., chest X-ray and CT) for diagnoses or prognoses of COVID-19
